test_scope: Actual PDS-listed DDR rw_fifo_ctrl and generated read/write FIFO plus vendor DRM model and sync_generator; local restored-stream entry wiring mirror. DDR controller AXI scheduling, image core, production top and HDMI/PCIe sinks are not instantiated.
vendor_version: PDS_2022.2-SP6.4 GTP_DRM9K and IPML FIFO v1.9/control v1.4
excluded_legacy_duplicate: ipcore/read_ddr_fifo uses 256-to-32 and is not the PDS active 256-to-16 FIFO
phase_history_warmup: Initial two reset-release clocks fill reference histories before steady-state sync checks; no active pixel or line check is skipped.

read_to_entry_phase.R0: FIFO accepts rd_en/de_o on rising edge. RGB565 response and ddr_stream VS/HS/DE become valid after R0.
read_to_entry_phase.R1: Common image_stage register captures FIFO response and ddr_stream controls on the following rising edge.
read_to_entry_phase.R2: A synchronous consumer samples the image_stage output. Test assertions run before NBA and therefore report read_to_entry=2.

checks: Original rw_fifo_ctrl frame-reset assertion/release is exercised before feeding data
Every low-halfword-first RGB565 pixel from 256-bit DDR source checked, including first and last
No FIFO empty at any active read and no full at any DDR write
Restored VS/HS/DE phase histories match both control and entry register stages
Each line contains exactly 1920 pixels and starts every 2200 pixel clocks
Full test uses original 1125/5/36/1080/4 vertical timing and confirms 79392 clocks from VS falling to first DE
Final FIFO empty; exact source write-block count and frame read-pixel count
warning_origin: First elaboration emits 24 unmodified vendor sdpram inactive address-width branch bit-select warnings (12 each in read/write FIFO). Final incremental cached runs can report zero; no warnings suppressed or vendor code changed.
limits: Functional vendor-model verification does not model physical routed setup/hold/recovery. Entry mirror confirms data/control phases but does not replace a relocated production-top or image-core regression.
